note: Weekly target = September monthly GA4 target x 7/30; the week straddles the month end (31 Aug plus 1–6 Sep) and is priced on September. Vesu remains excluded from the portfolio view. Hong Kong booked 999 GA4 bookings against a 899 blended weekly target, up 11.1 percent ahead of target, down 1.3 percent week on week and up 13.7 percent year on year. Five of six venues beat target. Cantina is the standout at +93.6 percent year on year and Shiro +45.8 percent, still carrying the Tai Kwun opening. Dim Sum Library is the one venue below target this week (−13.8 percent) and the only one down year on year (−27.6 percent); its conversion rate fell to 13.4 percent from 17.7 percent last year on similar traffic, so this is a conversion question rather than a demand one. Year to date the portfolio is up 6.5 percent ahead of target, with Aqua HK (−6.8 percent) and Dim Sum Library (−7.8 percent) the only venues behind.
